_comment: Battle of the Realm — the spoken cast.
The lines themselves are NOT here: tools/generate-voice.js reads them straight
out of scripts/battle/data.js, so editing the story never leaves the narration
quoting an old draft. Change a line there and re-run with --force for that id.
`voice` picks who says it. Put either an ElevenLabs voice ID or the exact name
of a voice in your account — run `node tools/generate-voice.js --list` to see
what you have. `description` is the character brief: paste it into ElevenLabs
Voice Design to build a bespoke voice, or let --design try to do it for you.
`settings` are ElevenLabs voice settings. Lower stability = more expressive and
more variable between takes; higher = steadier. The narrator wants steadiness,
Cast: George narrates, Brian is Glob, and the three henchmen have their own
voices — Callum, Harry and Charlie. Short names are fine here: the lookup
matches the leading name, so "George" finds "George - Warm, Captivating

narrator.description: A warm, unhurried storyteller reading a children's picture book aloud at bedtime. Kind and a little wondrous, with a gentle smile behind the voice. Clear enough for a six-year-old to follow, never syrupy, never sinister. Mid-range, softly resonant, unhurried pacing with room to breathe between images.

glob.description: A spoiled child king throwing a royal tantrum — petulant, gleeful and utterly self-important, the voice of someone who has never once been told no. Bratty and theatrical, swinging from sing-song boasting to outraged shrieking mid-sentence. Comic villainy for children, never genuinely frightening.

minyar.description: A whiny, wound-up little bully mid-tantrum — nasal, fast, indignant, forever on the edge of stamping a foot and telling on you. Comic and childish rather than menacing.
minyar.casting_note: Callum's husky trickster read, wound right up: low stability and high style so he rushes and cracks.

demonder.description: A gruff, swaggering brawler who thinks this is all a bit of fun — low, gravelly, amused, the sort who cracks his knuckles and grins. Confident and unhurried, tough but never nasty.
demonder.casting_note: Harry's warrior weight, pulled back to amused rather than raging — he thinks this is fun.

clubbo.description: An enormous, slow, simple-minded crusher — very deep, booming and rumbling, speaking in short blunt bursts with big pauses. Dim and weirdly good-natured underneath all the smashing. Lumbering, not evil.
clubbo.casting_note: Charlie is deep but energetic, so high stability and low style flatten him into slow blunt bursts.

casting._comment: which speaker reads each block of story text
